description: Control and expansion module with digital and NTC inputs, analog inputs and outputs and 16 relay outputs, Modbus RTU and TCP
source: Mercato ME46A - Manual de Serviço, Revision H, 2020-02-26
notes: Configuration is done in the web page of the module (factory address 10.1.1.240). The manual gives no factory Modbus address or serial speed: 9600 bit/s, 8 data bits, no parity and address 1 are assumed.
The manual does not give the Modbus function codes; the registers are read here as holding registers.
FLOAT values have the high word first.
The module has 18 or 26 digital inputs and 0 or 8 analog inputs depending on the model; the manual marks the registers that exist only on the ME46-D in red.
Days of a schedule: bit 7 is Monday and bit 1 Sunday.
Written from the manufacturer's manual; not tested on a device.
